justification: The Cayley graph is the Shrikhande graph, giving the reference pair. Both graphs have parameters (16,6,2,2), so their stable 2-WL classes have identical sizes 16, 96, and 144. They are non-isomorphic: the rook graph contains a 4-clique, while the Cayley graph’s neighborhoods are chordless 6-cycles, excluding any 4-clique.
